game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: sorax86
quote: 3 years of waiting for this. Rockstar promised a revolution, but delivered a desperately hollow marketing product, devoid of soul and utterly lacking in innovation.Sure, Vice City is impressive for the first couple of hours, but once the novelty wears off, you realize what it really is: a rigid movie set where you spend more time watching than actually playing. The missions recycle a formula that's twenty years old, the writing mistakes vulgarity for satire, and the gunplay feels straight out of 2013.Everything feels like GTA V: the motion capture, the voice acting, the cinematography, everything. Or does it? Not quite, actually. What's missing is the talent, the writing, the irreverence, and above all, the **** worst part? This pathological obsession with realism that turns every single action into a chore. Everything feels clunky, slow, and tedious. Rockstar became so obsessed with simulating real life that it forgot to make an entertaining game.Behind its undeniable technological showcase (albeit a buggy one running at 25 FPS), GTA VI embodies everything that's rotten about modern AAA gaming: self-congratulation and a complete unwillingness to take any risks when it comes to gameplay.A masterpiece of marketing. Utterly forgettable.
